messages:
sara: quick sync — pushed a small prototype branch for split-residency (hot vs cold prefix residency) + a tiny observability probe. want feedback on invariants we should assert in prod.
sara: branch: `feat/split-residency-observe` (WIP). main idea: keep small hot-residency set pinned, allow background demote to cold slab; expose transition events.
omar: pinged the thread, will take a look. high level Q: do we still allow soft-evict during demote window?
sara: yes, soft-evict allowed but we add a `demote_inflight` flag so reads can decide to wait or fast-path from cold.
devon: concern: ordering between demote completion and lease handoff. if demote finishes just after a handoff, we might lose residency expectations. need a clear epoch/marker.
matt: +1 for epoch markers. also need metrics for transitions: `prefix_demote_started`, `prefix_demote_committed`, `prefix_promote_request`, `prefix_transition_lag_ms`.
sara: adding those metric names now. thinking to emit tags: tenant, prefix_hash, target_slab. low-cardinality.
devon: low-cardinality good. add `transition_cause` tag: `evict_policy`, `memory_pressure`, `manual`, `tenant_request`.
omar: what about correctness checks? e.g., after demote, KV GET should either return a tombstone/empty or a consistent value. we should add an invariant check in debug builds that runs a read-verify against a short-lived persistent store snapshot.
sara: yeah I prototyped a `residency_probe` RPC that does `read->check-kv->compare`. by default it's off, can enable per-tenant prefectures.
matt: can we make a lightweight sampling mode in prod that hits the probe path at 0.1% to validate without perf impact?
sara: yep that's the plan. sampling + exponential backoff on errors to avoid storms.
devon: please add a guard to avoid races: probe should retry if it sees a `demote_inflight` transition and only compare after a stable epoch is observed twice.
sara: will implement. also adding logs like: `DEMOTE start: {epoch}` / `DEMOTE commit: {epoch} lat_ms`.
infra-bot: CI status: build passed for feat/split-residency-observe — tests: 218/218. :white_check_mark:
omar: nice. one more ops ask: expose a tiny dashboard (per-cluster) showing active hot-set size, demote/sec, failed-probes/sec. ops can alert on probe failure rate > 0.5% for 5m.
matt: +1. also recommend a canary rollout plan: enable sampling in canary cluster -> watch probe errors and transition_lag -> ramp.
sara: plan: (1) land probe + metrics + opt-in flag behind feature-flag, (2) canary rollout to canary cluster, (3) 0.1% sampling ramp -> 1% if stable, (4) enable soft invariants in debug builds, (5) docs.
omar: SGTM. can you put the branch link and checklist in the PR description?
sara: done, PR: https://git.redwood/infr/fe/split-residency-observe — checklist at bottom.
devon: small nit: add an API note for `prefix_pin` callers that they may observe transient miss during demote; recommend callers retry once.
sara: will add retry header `x-prefix-transition: retry-after=50ms` for callers that opt-in.
matt: thanks all. merging once CI and docs are green. :+1:
sara: thanks everyone. follow-ups in PR comments.
